prompt: Outliers usually affect which measure more: mean or median?
hint: Imagine one value in a list becoming huge. Think about what happens to the total and what happens to the middle position.

hints.text: Imagine one value in a list becoming huge. Think about what happens to the total and what happens to the middle position.
The mean is built from the sum of every value, so one extreme value changes it. The median only looks at which value is in the middle of the order.
Outliers affect the mean more than the median.

explanation: The mean adds up every value, so a very large or very small value changes the total and shifts the mean.
The median depends only on the middle position, and an outlier is still just one value at the end of the order.
That is why outliers usually affect the mean more than the median.
